ྈ'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs sgrub bzhugs so:mnga' paṇa rig 'dzin yongs 'dus/

tei:div.tei:p: "!# ྈ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs sgrub bzhugs so:

mnga' paṇa rig 'dzin yongs 'dus/ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ kun bzang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo: tshad med mkhyen pa'i yon tan myur 'grub phyir: 'jam dbyangs thugs kyi sgrub pa 'di nyid la: sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pas bstan: dang po skyabs 'gro tshad med sems bskyed cing: tshogs gsag chu gtor maṇ+ḍal tshogs la 'bad: khyad par byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni: mkha' la 'jam dbyangs lha tshogs dpag med rnams: sku dang ye shes rgyas pa'i ngo bo nyid: sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma'i ngo bor blta: de la gdung shugs gsol ba gdab pa ni: e ma ho: rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i pho brang du: sangs rgyas sku yi sprul pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs: steng 'og phyogs bzhir sku yis 'gro don mdzad: sku yi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor: 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs: zag med blo gros shes rab snang ba dang: tshig dang don bcas dbang 'byor byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru mañdzu shrī pra dz+nyā war+dha sid+dhi hūm̐: de ltar brgya stong bsnyen cing gsol ba gdab: thun mtshams 'jam dpal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: sngags kyi phreng ba gser gyi phreng ltar byung: bdag gi smin mtshams mdzod spu'i bu ga nas: rim gyis zhugs nas lus kyi nang kun gang: bde gshegs byang sems thugs rje'i byin rlabs rnams: yongs su rdzogs par thob par bsam byas te: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs lha tshogs rang la bstim: ma bcos 'gyur med mtha' bral ngang du bzhag: de ni sngon 'gro'i gdams pa e ma ho: ྈྈྈ ྈྈ gnyis pa bskyed bzlas rdzogs pa'i rim pa la: dang po rnam dag 'od lnga'i zhing khams su: stong rig shes pa muṃ yig gser gyi mdog: tsha zer rab 'phros mun pa 'joms par byed: de nyid gsal gdab mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri: pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du: 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo gur gum gsar pa'i mdog:

zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri ut+pal steng: stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam 'od zer 'bar: zhi ba gzhon nu zur phud 'od kyis mdzes: rin chen mang po'i rgyan 'phyang rab 'bar ba: 'khor du drwa ba can gyi 'od dang ni: skra can lha mo dbyangs kyi gsung ldan ma: sems dpa'i tshogs bcas shes dang shes bya'i bdag: ma lus gsal gdab ma yengs dar cig bsgom: gzhan yang rab dkar kun+da'i mdog can dang: ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'jam dbyangs sku ru bskyed: ྈྈ ྈྈྈ gnyis pa bzlas brjod dang po 'jam dbyangs kyi: thugs kar dwangs ma'i thig le zlum po'i nang: rab dkar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa: de steng muṃ la sngags kyis bskor bar blta: lce steng dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa: gsal gdab rlung bzung shes rab ma lus 'phrog: thugs ka'i 'khor lo dag la bstim zhing bzla: 'od zer ral gri phra mo'i tshogs 'phros pas: mi shes mun bcom shes rab 'phel bar bsam: gnyis pa dbugs kyi rtas bsgyur dhīḥmang bzla: de bzhin a a a zhes gsang sngags bzla: gsum pa ngag gi rang sgra sngags yin phyir: brjod pa thams cad yi ge drug par bzla: oṃ wā gi shwa ri muṃ: oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhī: oṃ wā kye daṃ na ma: de bzhin a yi sngags kyang brgya stong sogs: thun bzhir bcad de bzlas pas gzungs spobs dang: shes rab snying rje myur du thob par 'gyur: ྈྈ ྈྈྈ gsum pa rdzogs rim nam mkhar a dkar po: rgyu skar chen po dwangs gsal 'tsher ba ltar: a yig rang sgra rgyun du sgrog par bsgom: de don skye med yi ge a yin te: a yi rang bzhin brtags na sgra mthar stong: stong pa'i rang bzhin shes pas grol 'gyur phyir: stong nyid bco brgyad a la rnam par brtag: rang lus ar gyur a yang nam mkhar yal: a dang gnyis med mthar thug nam mkhar dag: mtha' dang dbus med de bzhin nyid kyi ngang: thog mtha' med pa'i rig pas grol 'gyur phyir:

zang thal ma bcos so mar lhan ner bzhag: skye med rang mdangs 'gag med 'od lngar gsal: gsal ba'i dus na ngo bo stong par gnas: gnyis med zung 'jug don la rtag tu bsgom: de ni dngos gzhi'i gdams pa e ma ho: ྈྈྈ ྈྈ rjes ni don dam mtshan rab brjod bya zhing: stong nyid snying rje'i rtsal sbyong bsngo ba bya: smon lam gdab cing 'gro don thos bsam sbyang: 'gag med rtogs na byang chub myur thob 'gyur: de ni rjes kyi gdams pa e ma ho: ྈྈྈ ྈྈ pad+ma rgyal po ye shes rol pa rtsal gyi gsang gter ro/// /
